To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1. The critical path is often not on the UI thread; 2. The critical path can change over time as the app is updated, and the app is used; 3. The critical path changes with the context in which the app is used.
the critical paths of user transactions in mobile apps are often short, and that the most common causes of performance problems are slow network calls and long-running tasks.
